nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
LamaToken.symbol public string, set to LAMA in the constructor.
LamaToken.name public string, set to 'Lama Token' in the constructor.
LamaToken.decimals public uint8, set to 18 in the constructor.
LamaToken._totalSupply: total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom/constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for owner checks, allowance keys and balance debits.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed inside approveAndCall; caller-supplied contract is invoked and can re-enter.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) inside transferAnyERC20Token on a caller-supplied token address.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(); not routed through SafeMath.safeSub.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b; require(c >= a);
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b;
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b);
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b;
Owned() constructor: owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: sets newOwner for two-step ownership transfer.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and moves ownership.
modifier onlyOwner { require(msg.sender == owner); _; } access-control guard used by transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token.
LamaToken() constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and credits the initial holder balance.
totalSupply() constant returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits to via safeAdd, emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens, emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits to.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts; contract rejects plain ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: forwards an external ERC20 transfer to owner.

edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the balance owner: balances[msg.sender] is read and debited.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller-controlled sender.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], keyed on the caller identity.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender both as allowance owner and as the from argument forwarded to the external callee.
acceptOwnership authorises on require(msg.sender == newOwner).
onlyOwner authorises privileged calls via require(msg.sender == owner).
Owned constructor assigns the deployer identity to the owner state variable.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
acceptOwnership reassigns the owner state variable after the msg.sender check.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the transfer.
transferOwnership stores the new pending owner supplied by the owner-only caller.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
approveAndCall writes state_allowed before making the external call, so the allowance state is stale during the call.
approveAndCall reaches the untrusted external receiveApproval call with an attacker-supplied spender contract.
The invoked spender contract can call back into approveAndCall / transferFrom while allowance state is mid-update.
transferAnyERC20Token reaches the external ERC20Interface call on a caller-supplied token address.
The arbitrary token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token can execute code that re-enters this contract (call is owner-gated).
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)] without SafeMath.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction instead of routing through SafeMath.safeSub.
The unchecked subtraction operates directly on the _totalSupply state variable.
safeSub performs checked arithmetic that would have guarded the totalSupply subtraction.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transfer mutates state_balances for msg.sender and to.
transferFrom mutates state_balances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in state_allowed.
approve writes the allowance into state_allowed.
balanceOf reads state_balances for the queried account.
allowance reads state_allowed for the owner/spender pair.
LamaToken constructor sets _totalSupply to 100000000000.
LamaToken constructor credits the full supply to the fixed holder address.
LamaToken constructor sets symbol = 'LAMA'.
LamaToken constructor sets name = 'Lama Token'.
LamaToken constructor sets decimals = 18.
